facts.fact: UNICEF's Lesotho office reports the Ntlafatsa Bana project launched a tablet-based digital birth registration system in Ha-Tankele, run by Village Health Workers and Civil Registration Officers and integrated with the NISSA social assistance database.
facts.system: Ntlafatsa Bana digital birth registration system
